title: Neural Supervised Clustering for Learning Individualized Treatment Rules with Many Treatments
abstract: arXiv:2610.19104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning an individualized treatment rule (ITR) with many treatments requires estimating treatment-specific effects from limited observations per arm. Treatments with similar conditional responses can share information, but linear contrast models may miss nonlinear heterogeneity. We propose nonlinear supervised clustering fusion (NSCF), a neural Q-learning framework with a shared nonlinear covariate representation and low-dimensional treatment embeddings. Pairwise fusion groups treatments with similar learned contrasts, yielding an ITR and an interpretable partition. An alternating algorithm combines neural training, embedding fusion, validation-based partition selection, and unpenalized grouped refitting. NSCF lowers regret relative to a strong neural reference in nonlinear exact-sharing simulations; perturbations characterize the limits of hard sharing. translated_title: 用于学习多治疗方案个体化治疗规则的神经监督聚类方法
translated_abstract: 在存在多种治疗方案的情况下学习个体化治疗规则（ITR），需要从每个治疗臂有限的观测数据中估计治疗特异性效应。具有相似条件响应的治疗方案本可以共享信息，但线性对比模型可能无法捕捉非线性的异质性。我们提出了非线性监督聚类融合方法（NSCF），这是一个神经Q学习框架，包含共享的非线性协变量表示和低维治疗嵌入。通过成对融合，该方法将学习到的对比效应相似的治疗方案归为一组，从而得到一个个体化治疗规则和一个可解释的划分结构。我们设计了一种交替算法，将神经网络训练、嵌入融合、基于验证集的划分选择以及无惩罚的分组重新拟合相结合。在非线性精确共享的模拟实验中，NSCF相较于强大的神经基准方法降低了遗憾值；扰动分析刻画了硬共享机制的适用边界。在黑色素瘤异种移植应用中，NSCF提高了平均策略价值……
tldr: 提出了一种结合共享非线性协变量表示、低维治疗嵌入与成对聚类融合的神经Q学习框架NSCF，能够从每个治疗臂有限的观测数据中学习多治疗方案下的个体化治疗规则，并生成可解释的治疗分组划分。
en_tdlr: NSCF is proposed, a neural Q-learning framework combining shared nonlinear covariate representations, low-dimensional treatment embeddings, and pairwise clustering fusion, which learns individualized treatment rules with many treatments from limited per-arm observations while yielding an interpretable treatment partition.
